audit.why: Lane difficulty EVEN 5.5/10 is fair: Pantheon dominates early, Sylas out-scales at two items. Content layer describes this accurately.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart says 'Skill' on all 7 rows while content win[] and packet chart say Pantheon L1-first item, Sylas at 2+ items.
audit.why: Content layer and packet agree; full layer carries a blanket Skill. Sides moved to match, whys rewritten grounded in kit (Kingslayer 12s CD, Hijack, Chain Lash).
audit.corrected: phases sides Pantheon x6, Sylas at 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; enemyWin was the measured template sentence.
audit.why: Sylas E (Abscond/Abduct) is 13s rank 1, W Kingslayer 12s rank 1, R Hijack 80/55/30. Pantheon W stun interrupts his lunge; Aegis blocks Chain Lash detonation. Grounded these into the fields.
Anti-heal into Kingslayer already present in report[8]; missing-interactions item covered.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Aegis Assault has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Sylas E (Abscond/Abduct): 13s at rank 1, 9s maxed — his only engage. When he burns it you have a ten-second window to W-stun and trade free. - Kingslayer is 12s early: stun him mid-lunge and the heal never lands. - Hold your E for the burst that follows his chain pull, not for poke.

edits.before: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit.
edits.after: His bases are weak pre-6 — Shield Vault stuns before Kingslayer heals; exit before his chains spin up.

edits.before: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: Past two items stacked AP and health inflate Kingslayer's heal — once your E is spent, a long duel is his to out-sustain.

edits.before: Sylas wins by landing Abscond / Abduct, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Sylas wins by hoarding Hijack for your Grand Starfall, healing through chip with Kingslayer, and scaling past your two-item fall-off.

edits.before: Q the contacts — the spear chunks at one and the empowered version executes; mid rarely respects either.
edits.after: Comet Spear chunks at 575 range and Sylas's level-1 Chain Lash is his only answer — you win every Q trade.

edits.before: W point-and-click stun joins: the level 2 all-in is the lane's first ultimatum. Most mids pay it.
edits.after: Shield Vault's point-and-click stun joins: the W-Q all-in beats Sylas before Kingslayer sustain exists.

edits.before: Full kit: W-stun, empowered Q or E-block — you out-trade everything for five levels. Spend the window loudly.
edits.after: Full kit: Aegis blocks his Chain Lash detonation and W stuns him out of Abscond — every short trade is yours.

edits.before: Empowered-spear the step-ups and block the answer with E — the lane is a toll road with a spear booth.
edits.after: Keep punishing his 12s Kingslayer cooldown — empowered spears deny the health his heal needs to matter.

edits.before: Grand Starfall online — your shoves become bot-lane invoices. The early lead must become the map now.
edits.after: Hijack steals Grand Starfall, but the raw 1v1 stays yours — W stun interrupts his Kingslayer windup.

edits.before: First item spike: the stun-spear rotation deletes squishies. Last call before scaling lanes wake.
edits.after: Eclipse spike: the stun-spear rotation still bursts him before his heal matters. Last call — spend it.

edits.before: Late Pantheon is a starting pistol: R the flank, stun the carry, block the counter — and let the team finish what the spear started.
edits.after: Stacked AP and health inflate Kingslayer's heal past your burst — Sylas out-sustains long fights now, so open for your team and exit.
